authority: User additions to floor-height version 2469bb79: startup-only ground-truth output contract on all 20 dev episodes and post-screen normal-start comparison; screen unchanged.
execution_order: Wait for existing C1 screen owner to close; baseline calibration; freeze numerical tolerance; 20 startup contracts; five read-only recording comparisons.
concurrency: Existing exact concurrency qualification is explicitly C3-only; no extra simulator/renderer owner alongside C1.
calibration: Original C3 primary mapping path only, versus native ground plane expressed in the mapper start frame. Do not evaluate V1 before the tolerance is frozen.
tolerance_rule: max(0.002 m, ceil(2 * maximum absolute old primary-path error / 0.001 m) * 0.001 m); stop if this exceeds 0.005 m. Freeze numerical value before all V1 tests.
tolerance_rationale: Twice the measured primary-path maximum, rounded upward to millimetres; 2-mm minimum equals existing depth-noise scale. A 5-mm ceiling keeps the allowance below half the mapping 10-mm floor-height band and prevents calibration from legitimising a large bias.
contract: Absolute initial scalar map-floor-height error versus native horizontal collision ground, at the map-origin vertical, <= frozen tolerance. All 20 starts must qualify. New and C3 maps receive the identical actual startup sensor/registered-pose packet; ground truth stays evaluator-only.
startup_scope: 1.5-s original settling and first consumed packet only; zero mission commands/planning decisions. An unavailable initial output is unresolved and reported before a next change; do not silently substitute or extend the attempt.
native_reference: world_from_map = settled_world_from_body @ initial_from_map; ground world Z=0 verified from native collision-floor position/quaternion; transform its plane into each mapper frame.
comparison: Every native field (dtype/shape/value), full request dictionaries and every consumed sensor hash; report first differences and missing runs without replacements.
accounting: No zero charge: implemented mapping change also affects normal starts. Preserve comparisons and c3-v1 contract evidence; do not retrospectively alter V1.
stop_rule: Report any failed or unresolved start before a next harness change. Preserve all failed attempts. Running screen remains unchanged.
